message: The compile-time '{0}' loop is not allowed here because it is part of a block whose execution depends on the run-time condition '{1}'. Move the loop out of the run-time-conditional block or use a compile-time 'foreach' loop instead.
title: Cannot have a compile-time loop in a block whose execution depends on a run-time condition.
rationale: Grammar defect ('it is a part of block' instead of 'it is part of a block'), and the advice misses the most common fix: the check in TemplateAnnotator.RequireLoopScope applies only to 'while' and 'do' loops, so a compile-time 'foreach' loop is allowed in the same block. The title lacks the final period.
